moments.title: Old Bennington
moments.text: On a hill above downtown, the Old First Church of 1806 shares the village with a 306-foot stone obelisk raised for a battle that was actually fought over the line in New York.

moments.title: Hildene
moments.text: Robert Todd Lincoln's summer house of 1905 stands on a promontory over the Battenkill Valley, beside a garden laid out in privet in the pattern of a stained-glass window.
